killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole still carries the rules the features depend on
why: Renames the screen-reader-only rule, so everything carrying that class is drawn. That is both Records tables' captions (issue #640) and the live announcement line (issue #629) -- a visual regression produced BY an accessibility feature, which is the direction nobody looks in, and the announcement line would appear under the toast stack narrating the player's own lives at them. Renamed to `.ui-visually-hidden`, which shares no prefix: the guard asserts with `toContain`, and a first draft using a `-renamed` SUFFIX survived because the new selector still contained the original as a substring -- the same trap this file already records for `.hud-achievements-open`, met for the third time in this repository.
